board-minutes-of-meeting.14: Hence accuracy matters. Under SS-1 practice, once signed, minutes should not be altered; any correction should be approved at a later meeting and recorded in that meeting's minutes.
board-minutes-of-meeting.15: Yes. Indian companies can hold board meetings through video conferencing or other audio-visual means, subject to the rules and certain restricted matters. Minutes must record which directors attended through video conferencing, and the chairperson must confirm attendance and quorum.
